recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If historical Extension Pack metadata for retired/deprecated observation-focusCode needs review, handle that separately in the Extension Pack rather than changing current core source.
issue_request: FHIR-5727 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request from DSTU1 asking that the Observation indirect target, later called focal-subject, be made a modifier extension because it changes interpretation of an Observation such as fetal heart rate in the mother's record.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in svn revision 7998, preserved as git commit 9d17fe9388, which changed the focal-subject row in source/observation/observation-extensions-spreadsheet.xml to mark it as a modifier. Related earlier work in FHIR-8379 renamed the confusing indirectTarget extension to focal-subject.
additional_context: The old extension is no longer an active core definition. Observation is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml marks Observation.focus isModifier=true. Later applied issue FHIR-37736 and commit 7a5dceb812 explicitly added that flag and reason to Observation.focus. The FHIR Extension Pack retains only a retired/deprecated observation-focusCode extension that directs users to Observation.focus.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current in-build core source already carries the modifier semantics required by FHIR-5727 and no authoritative core source edit is needed.
